more_info.daily_intake: 0.03 mg ferrocyanide ion/kg body weight/day, combined ferrocyanides (EFSA, 2018).
more_info.side_effects:
Assessed food uses raised no concern.
Higher-dose animal kidney effects supported the group limit.
more_info.overview: Calcium ferrocyanide is a calcium salt of the hexacyanoferrate(II) complex, specified in hydrated crystalline form. Its anti-caking role is to reduce the tendency of particles in a food powder to stick together. The specified material is supplied as yellow powder or crystalline material.
